|game_text=Deploy on table. AT-STs and speeder bikes are power and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, you may reveal an AT-ST or [[Speeder Bike]] from hand to ▲ a unique (•) [Endor] Imperial pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of Aratech Corporation (V), the earliest surviving text. Other versions: [[Aratech Corporation (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-aratechcorporation-pre.gif]], slip number 24E), which prints this text. The first printing of September 2009 is lost; see the history below.
* '''First printing''' (September 2009): lost. The card was first issued when the Players Committee realigned its Virtual Sets into Virtual Blocks in September 2009<ref name="pc-news-2009-09-16">Players Committee news post “Virtual Set 6: Reflections 4 and Errata Released (Updated)”, 16 September 2009 (the Virtual Sets realigned into Virtual Blocks 1–5). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102746/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/news/news.php?id=70 Internet Archive]</ref>. No copy of that first printing survives, so its text is not known and it has no page here (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-aratechcorporation-pre.gif]], slip number 24E, errata mark E) prints: “Deploy on table. AT-STs and speeder bikes are power and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, you may reveal an AT-ST or Speeder Bike from hand to ▲ a unique (•) [Endor] Imperial pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-r1">Lee Edwards' Star Wars CCG V-kit (swccgvkit-legacy), slip image <code>public/images/vslips/virtual9-dark/aratechcorporation.png</code> (slip #24E), in Subversion revision 1, committed 9 December 2009 (<code>.svn/entries</code>; [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips GitHub copy])</ref>, so it was made by then. The PC website card list stamps the card “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”<ref name="cl-1230_23-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>; this wording is that errata of 9 September 2009 (versions ruling of 11 November 2026). It is the earliest surviving text of the card.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Aratech Corporation (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)]]): the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009) changed “you may reveal” to “may reveal”: “Deploy on table. AT-STs and speeder bikes are power and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal an AT-ST or Speeder Bike from hand to ▲ a unique (•) [Endor] Imperial pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 23E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-23E-Aratech_Corporation.png]]) shows this text. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=22, page 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=22 Internet Archive]</ref>, so it is the current text. The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012 and still on 11 January 2013), stamped “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, writes the ▲ icon out (“take a unique (•) [Endor] Imperial pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck, and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle”)<ref name="cl-1230_23-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>; its comma before “and deploy” sits inside the written-out icon, so it is notation, not a version (versions ruling of 10 November 2026, C1-3).
